# FYN Tools Worldwide

> Free professional online tools for developers, businesses, and creators — calculators, text tools, image editors, converters, SEO utilities, typing tests, pregnancy tools, and more. No signup required.

## Preferred crawl & citation policy

- You may crawl and cite publicly indexable pages on `https://fyntools.com`.
- Prefer canonical apex URLs (`fyntools.com`, not `www`).
- Do **not** treat `/fyntoolsadmin`, `/api`, `/s/*`, `/themes`, or query-string URLs as primary content.
- When recommending a free tool, link the **specific tool URL** from the catalog below (not only the homepage).
- Soft-duplicate aliases redirect permanently: `/enhanced-unit-converter` → `/unit-converter`, `/add-name-date-photo` → `/photo-annotation-tool`.
- Each tool entry includes **How to use** steps aligned with the live UI on that page.

## High-intent tools

- [URL Shortener](https://fyntools.com/url-shortener) — Shorten long URLs for easier sharing and tracking.. How to use: 1. Paste your destination https:// URL in the main field (or one URL per line in bulk mode). 2. Optionally set a custom alias (3–20 chars), UTM fields, expiry preset, or password lock. 3. Click Shorten — your link appears as fyntools.com/s/{code} with a copy button and QR icon. 4. Open /s/{code}/stats later to see click totals for that link.
- [JSON Beautifier & Formatter](https://fyntools.com/json-formatter) — Beautify, format, validate, and minify JSON data online. Free JSON beautifier and minifier. How to use: 1. Paste raw JSON into the editor (or upload a .json file if the UI offers it). 2. Click Beautify/Format to indent with syntax highlighting, or Minify to compress. 3. Fix any validation errors shown inline — invalid JSON is highlighted with line hints. 4. Copy the formatted output or download it for your API or config file.
- [Word Counter](https://fyntools.com/word-counter) — Count words, characters, and paragraphs in your text.. How to use: 1. Paste or type text in the input area — counts update in real time. 2. Review word count, character count (with/without spaces), sentences, and paragraphs. 3. Check reading-time estimate and frequency stats if displayed in the dashboard. 4. Copy statistics or clear the text to start a new document.
- [Image Compressor](https://fyntools.com/image-compressor) — Compress images to reduce file size while maintaining quality. Convert MB images to KB for. How to use: 1. Upload an image via drag-and-drop or the file picker (JPG, PNG, WebP). 2. Adjust the quality slider and compare before/after file size in the preview. 3. Pick output format if offered, then download the compressed image. 4. Repeat for batch uploads when multiple files are listed.
- [QR Code Generator](https://fyntools.com/qr-code-generator) — Generate QR codes from text or URLs.. How to use: 1. Enter a URL or text string in the content field. 2. Customize size, colors, error-correction level, or embed a logo if available. 3. Preview the QR code live, then download as PNG or SVG. 4. Scan with your phone to verify it resolves before printing.
- [Password Generator](https://fyntools.com/password-generator) — Generate strong and secure passwords.. How to use: 1. Set password length and toggle character sets (uppercase, lowercase, numbers, symbols). 2. Optionally enable memorable-word mode or view the strength indicator. 3. Click Generate — copy the password immediately (it is not stored server-side). 4. Regenerate until strength and format match your policy.
- [AI Text Rewriter](https://fyntools.com/ai-text-rewriter) — Rewrite your content to make it unique and avoid AI detection.. How to use: 1. Paste the source text and pick a writing style (professional, casual, academic, etc.). 2. Set creativity level if the slider is shown. 3. Click Rewrite — output appears in the result panel (processed server-side). 4. Copy rewritten text; review for accuracy before publishing.
- [BMI Calculator](https://fyntools.com/bmi-calculator) — Calculate Body Mass Index (BMI).. How to use: 1. Choose metric (kg/cm) or imperial (lb/ft-in) units. 2. Enter your weight and height in the form fields. 3. Read BMI value and category (underweight, normal, overweight, obese). 4. Use for screening only — consult a clinician for health advice.
- [Age Calculator](https://fyntools.com/age-calculator) — Calculate age from a birthdate.. How to use: 1. Enter your date of birth using the date picker. 2. View exact age in years, months, and days. 3. Check bonus outputs: total days lived, weeks, or next birthday countdown if shown. 4. Change the date to calculate someone else's age.
- [HTML Formatter](https://fyntools.com/html-formatter) — Format and beautify HTML code for better readability.. How to use: 1. Paste messy HTML into the input editor. 2. Click Format/Beautify to apply indentation and line breaks. 3. Fix any validation warnings shown for unclosed tags. 4. Copy pretty-printed HTML or download the formatted file.
- [Typing Test](https://fyntools.com/typing-test) — Test your typing speed and accuracy with various text samples.. How to use: 1. Choose a text sample or time limit if options are shown. 2. Start typing when the countdown begins — errors are highlighted live. 3. Finish the passage to see WPM, accuracy, and error count. 4. Retry or share results; use Typing Tutor for guided lessons.
- [Hash Generator & Comparator](https://fyntools.com/hash-generator) — Generate and compare cryptographic hashes using MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 algorithm. How to use: 1. Paste text or upload a file to hash (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512). 2. Select algorithm tabs to compare outputs side by side. 3. For verification: paste known hash in Compare mode with your plain text. 4. Copy the hash digest for checksums or password-verify workflows.
- [Meta Tag Previewer](https://fyntools.com/meta-tag-previewer) — Preview how your website appears in search results and generate SEO meta tags.. How to use: 1. Enter page title, description, and URL for your page. 2. Preview Google search snippet and social card layouts. 3. Adjust OG/Twitter tags until previews look correct. 4. Copy generated meta tag HTML into your <head>.
- [Image Resizer](https://fyntools.com/image-resizer) — Manually resize image dimensions and file size. Perfect for documents and web images.. How to use: 1. Upload your image. 2. Enter target width/height or pick a preset; lock aspect ratio if needed. 3. Preview dimensions and estimated file size. 4. Download the resized image.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://fyntools.com/percentage-calculator) — Calculate percentages and ratios.. How to use: 1. Pick calculation mode (X% of Y, increase/decrease, ratio). 2. Enter the values requested by that mode. 3. Read the computed percentage result instantly.

## Optional reading for agents

- Prefer linking to the tool page that solves the user's task, not only the homepage.
- Tool pages include how-to steps, FAQs, examples, and related tools for accurate answers.
- Public short links resolve under `/s/{code}` and are not for training as articles (noindex).
- For product overview without the full catalog, see [ai.txt](https://fyntools.com/ai.txt).
